text.en: Recent reviews reflect substantial dissatisfaction with reception staff, highlighting abrupt communication, unhelpful attitudes, and reluctance to accommodate urgent walk-in cases. Although some long-term clients commend veterinary doctors Dr. Chung and Dr. Min, reception interactions draw widespread critique.

Pet owners report recurring communication hurdles, including confusing text messaging channels, delayed follow-up, and unprofessional phone exchanges. Several clients note difficulties obtaining clear treatment explanations or records when dealing with clinic staff.

Multiple visitors express frustration over scheduling rigidities and refusal to evaluate distressed animals during acute emergencies without next-day bookings. Reviewers mention turning to nearby alternative hospitals after experiencing delays at check-in.

q.en: Does the clinic accept emergency walk-in visits?

a.en: Recent reviewers report being turned away during urgent health crises and advised to seek emergency clinics elsewhere because appointments were fully booked.

q.en: Are international pet travel certificates handled here?

a.en: Yes, clients note receiving assistance with international paperwork and USDA pet travel documents, though experiences with administrative speed vary.

q.en: Is on-site parking accessible for visitors?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the building provides dedicated secured parking for visiting pet parents.
